text: Those are just official numbers. My uncle paid for 8 years and they still rejected him for a pre-existing disease. How is that fair?

I understand your concern. According to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, para 13, after 5 years of continuous cover, an insurer can't reject a claim for non‑disclosure or misrepresentation, except established fraud; policy exclusions still apply. If the policy had been continuous for more than five years, how would that affect the outcome you expect?
